title: Quarterly OKR runway + contingency buffer for Hosted API & model catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: produce a single, actionable quarter-level runway that aligns Hosted API product milestones with the model catalog rotation/deprecation schedule while preserving a 10% capacity contingency buffer to handle capacity churn, emergent model regressions, or partner region outages. This ticket drives the PM-side coordination work: capture OKR mappings, quantify unit-cost delta for each proposed rotation, define canary windows and rollback criteria, and produce stakeholder-approved communication templates for model deprecation and variant promotion.

Scope: (1) OKR mapping from top-level product OKRs to model catalog line items, (2) a prioritized quarter runway with dates, owners, and contingency slots, (3) canary + fallback playbook (timing, metrics, alert thresholds), (4) customer-facing deprecation notice templates and internal rollout checklist, (5) cost and latency delta table for each candidate rotation, and (6) handoff artifacts for Release, Eng, and Solutions teams.

Out of scope: detailed kernel/runtime optimization tasks (tracked separately under ENG tickets), infra procurement commitments for Dedicated customers, and non-hosted API model catalogs (private-only catalogs).
acceptance_criteria: OKR mapping table completed and reviewed by Product and GTM
Runway calendar published with owners + contingency slots and approved by Eng leads
Canary playbook with success/failure thresholds documented and linked to Console dashboards
Deprecation and promotion templates approved by Legal & Communications
Cost/latency delta spreadsheet attached with model variant comparisons
Handoff packet uploaded to Drive and linked in this ticket

updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff completed with Eng/Design/SRE. Assigned Eng inputs for cost delta to ENG-19421.

2025-03-01: Design pushed notice templates (Drive: /rdw/confluence/hosted-deprecation-notices) and mock banner flows for Console. Design review meeting scheduled 2025-03-03.

notes: Trade-off: larger contingency reduces capacity available for new commitments; recommended to reserve contingency from burst capacity where possible.
Open question: whether to treat small-precision-quantized variants as 'compatible fallback'—Eng and Research to confirm compatibility matrix by 2025-03-09.
Comms plan: two-step external notice (advance + one-week reminder) and an in-console banner for any deprecation with >10% behavior delta.
